inj.note: Charbonnet is set to see his first action of the season Monday night, and with him first in line during warmups it appears he will jump right into Seattle's starting lineup. While Charbonnet will likely be the first man up in the backfield, he is coming off knee surgery and will be one of four Seahawks running backs available -- Jadarian Price, Emanuel Wilson and George Holani being the others -- so it's unclear exactly what type of workload he will handle in his season debut.

news.h: Zach Charbonnet, Jadarian Price have no game designations for Monday
news.d: Seahawks running backs Zach Charbonnet and Jadarian Price have no game designations, meaning both are healthy enough to play Monday night against the Bears.
